title: AI policy
description: The organization documents and approves an AI policy that sets its direction and commitments for developing, providing or using AI systems responsibly.

title: Alignment with other organizational policies
description: The AI policy is aligned with, and cross-references, the organization's other policies (e.g. security, privacy, quality, safety) so obligations do not conflict.

title: Review of the AI policy
description: The AI policy is reviewed at planned intervals, and when significant changes occur, to confirm it remains suitable, adequate and effective.

title: AI roles and responsibilities
description: Roles and responsibilities for the AI management system and for the AI systems in scope are defined, assigned and communicated.

title: Reporting of concerns
description: A mechanism lets people raise concerns about the organization's AI systems, and defines how those concerns are handled.

title: Resource documentation
description: The resources needed for the AI system life cycle (data, tooling, compute, human expertise) are identified and documented.

title: Data resources
description: Data resources used by AI systems are documented, including their characteristics, origin and intended use.

title: Tooling resources
description: Tooling used to develop, operate and maintain AI systems is documented, including its purpose and any relevant limitations.

title: System and computing resources
description: The computing and system resources supporting the AI system life cycle are documented, including infrastructure and environments.

title: Human resources
description: The human resources and competences required across the AI system life cycle are identified, documented and made available.

title: AI system impact assessment process
description: The organization defines and applies a process to assess the potential consequences of its AI systems for individuals, groups and society.

title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
description: The results of AI system impact assessments are documented and retained.

title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups
description: Impact assessments consider potential harms and benefits to individuals or groups of individuals, including to their rights.

title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
description: Impact assessments consider broader societal impacts, such as effects on the environment, economy, or public institutions.

title: Objectives for responsible development of AI systems
description: The organization identifies and documents objectives that guide the responsible development of its AI systems.

title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
description: Processes for the responsible design and development of AI systems are defined and applied across the life cycle.

title: AI system requirements and specification
description: Requirements for each AI system are specified, including functional, performance and responsible-AI requirements.

title: Documentation of AI system design and development
description: The design and development of AI systems is documented to a level that supports verification, operation and later review.

title: AI system verification and validation
description: AI systems are verified and validated against their requirements before deployment, with criteria and results documented.

title: AI system deployment
description: AI systems are deployed following a defined process that confirms deployment criteria and readiness are met.

title: AI system operation and monitoring
description: AI systems in operation are monitored against defined criteria, and issues are identified and acted on.

title: AI system technical documentation
description: Technical documentation for each AI system is produced and kept available for relevant interested parties.

title: AI system recording of event logs
description: AI systems record event logs sufficient to support traceability, monitoring, investigation and accountability.

title: Data for development and enhancement of AI systems
description: The organization defines and documents the data requirements for developing and enhancing its AI systems.

title: Acquisition of data
description: Data is acquired in line with defined requirements and with a record of its source and the terms under which it may be used.

title: Quality of data for AI systems
description: The quality of data used by AI systems is assessed against defined criteria appropriate to the intended use.

title: Data provenance
description: The provenance of data used by AI systems is recorded and maintained over the data life cycle.

title: Data preparation
description: Data preparation methods (e.g. cleaning, labelling, transformation) are defined, documented and applied consistently.

title: System documentation and information for users
description: Documentation is provided to users that explains how to use the AI system appropriately and its relevant limitations.

title: External reporting
description: The organization provides a way for affected parties to report adverse impacts of its AI systems, and defines how reports are handled.

title: Communication of incidents
description: The organization defines and applies a process to communicate AI system incidents to relevant interested parties.

title: Information for interested parties
description: Relevant information about AI systems (e.g. purpose, responsible party, obligations) is made available to interested parties.

title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
description: Processes for the responsible use of AI systems are defined, documented and applied.

title: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
description: The organization identifies and documents objectives that guide the responsible use of AI systems.

title: Intended use of the AI system
description: AI systems are used in line with their intended purpose and the conditions and limitations set by the provider.

title: Allocating responsibilities
description: Responsibilities across the AI value chain are allocated and agreed between the organization, its suppliers and its customers.

title: Suppliers
description: The organization sets responsible-AI expectations for suppliers and verifies that supplied components and services meet them.

title: Customers
description: The organization provides customers with the information and support needed to use its AI systems responsibly.
